title: Polish Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Polish sausage, vividly colored vegetables, and a peppery kick.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the carrots into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Seed and chop the pepper into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality tomato paste for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots, bell pepper, and potatoes to the pot.
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the sausage to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
